dedupe_keys.name: roofscenex rooftop segmentation and building occupancy labels from satellite imagery in nine cities

description: RoofSceneX is a high-resolution satellite imagery dataset for building rooftop segmentation and building occupancy classification under difficult conditions such as cloud, vegetation occlusion, shadow, complex roofs and dense urban patterns. It was published on Zenodo on 16 March 2026 (version 1.0.0) by Davood Saadati and Attaollah Safdari of Guangzhou University. It holds 49,283 manually annotated rooftop instances from nine geographically diverse cities at 30 cm resolution, as 512 by 512 pixel tiles with binary rooftop masks and colour-coded occupancy labels, plus model scripts and trained benchmark models (MobileUNet+, UNet, AttUNet+, ViTAttUNet+ and YOLO26). Coverage: nine cities worldwide, not named in the record. Access: files are restricted on Zenodo and must be requested. Licence: listed as Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: restricted access, and the associated paper was not yet published. Simulation uses: building occupancy mapping for exposure models where cadastral use data are missing. Related records: OpenBuildingMap and the Kigali building footprints.
name: RoofSceneX: rooftop segmentation and building occupancy labels from satellite imagery in nine cities
